# 1on1 Sam - 2026-09-11

**Time:** 45 min, Friday 1 PM
**Person:** [[Sam Whitfield]]

## What Sam brought up

**Readiness review fallout.** Yesterday's SOC 2 readiness review found three gaps, and Sam wanted to walk through each with a plan rather than an apology. Good instinct.

1. **Quarterly access reviews are late.** Q3 hasn't started. Process exists, people don't do it. Managers sit on review requests for weeks.
2. **Vendor risk assessments missing for 4 vendors.** Sam is doing DriveWealth and Lithic first; those are the ones Northfield and the auditor will look at hardest.
3. **MDM on 88% of laptops.** Need 100%. The last 12% are mostly engineers who think MDM is surveillance, plus two people who just ignore the emails.

We're ten weeks into a six-month Type II window that started Jul 1. A late access review is an observation. A pattern of late access reviews is an exception.

Risk: a missed Q3 access review becomes a Type II exception and shows up in the Series B diligence read.

**Air cover.** Sam needs an exec to say "this is not optional." People ignore a security engineer they hired in June. They don't ignore the CTO. Fair, and slightly embarrassing that Sam had to ask.

## What I brought up

**How the first three months have felt.** Sam was honest: the Type I was clean (two observations) and that made everyone think SOC 2 is done. It isn't. Type II is about doing it every quarter, which is the boring part people skip.

**Where I'm a bottleneck.** I'm the SOC 2 sponsor, and Sam has been waiting on me for sign-offs that don't need me. Agreed: Sam signs evidence packages; I only see exceptions.

Decision: Sam signs off routine SOC 2 evidence; Maya only reviews exceptions.

## Commitments

- [x] Me: message to all managers on access reviews, Monday
- [x] Me: MDM note to eng, same day, with a date
- [ ] Sam: Q3 access review complete by 2026-10-10
- [ ] Sam: vendor risk assessments for the 4 missing vendors by 2026-10-24
- [ ] Sam: MDM to 100% with IT by 2026-10-17

## Read on Sam

Quiet, precise, and better at this than the title says. Will not escalate on their own, which is why I need to ask. Check in every other week until the gaps close.
